text:
rachel_finance: FYI found a split-billing bug on NeuroPath private renewal NP-2024-410. Partner-managed nodes should pay 20% of platform fee; customer pays 80%. Invoice shows the partner bearing 100% of the platform fee instead.
omar_am: That would undercharge us to the customer? or overcharge the partner?
rachel_finance: Overcharged partner. Net effect: partner invoice got billed $12,600 platform fee; customer invoice shows $0 platform fee. Contractually customer owes $50,400 platform fee (80% of $63k) but got billed nothing. Partner already paid $12,600.
kevin_ops: How did this happen? Any recent changes to the partner billing flow?
rachel_finance: Quick root cause: renewal import rule RULE-PARTNER-SPLIT had a missing conditional for private deployments with partner_billing=true. Migration MIG-2024-09 defaulted partner share to 100% when partner_billing flag present. Ticket OPS-1522 created.
billing_bot: LEDGER SNAPSHOT: Account NEUROPATH-CUST invoice NP-2024-410 shows platform fee $0; Partner account NEUROPATH-PARTNER invoice PP-2024-78 shows platform fee $12,600. Expected: Customer platform fee $50,400, Partner share $12,600. Delta: Customer underbilled $50,400; Partner overbilled $38,400 (we invoiced partner full 63k instead of 12.6k). Net AR difference = 0 (we booked incorrectly between AR accounts) but contractual obligations must be corrected.
omar_am: Customer called — they noticed missing platform charge on portal and are worried about a sudden bill later. They requested we correct to avoid surprise.
rachel_finance: Options: 1) Rerun invoices to reallocate platform fee to customer and issue partner credit memo for $38,400; 2) Leave partner invoice and bill customer for $50,400 (late surprise). We should do #1 and notify both parties. Partner already paid; we must issue refund/credit and get sign-off for >$25k credit? Partner overcharge is $38,400 so VP Finance approval required.
kevin_ops: Ops will patch RULE-PARTNER-SPLIT and add a pre-apply validation to ensure sum of split equals expected platform total. OPS-1522 ETA 2 days.
billing_bot: CREDIT/REFUND PREVIEW: Partner account NEUROPATH-PARTNER | Suggested credit memo: $38,400 | Options: apply_credit_to_partner (account balance negative) or refund_ach. Customer account NEUROPATH-CUST | Suggested new invoice: $50,400 platform fee will be created and posted.
omar_am: Customer wants proactive notice and a payment plan if they prefer. Let's not surprise them; create invoice and give 30-day payment window.
rachel_finance: Routing for approval to VP Finance: request issue partner credit memo $38,400 and apply to partner account (refund if partner requests). Create corrected invoice for customer $50,400 with NET-30. Require VP Finance sign-off for partner credit > $25k. Also capture remediation plan and confirmation to customer and partner.
vp_finance: Reviewing. Need confirmation this is internal reallocation (no net revenue change) and tax neutrality. Also confirm partner contract terms allow crediting.
rachel_finance: Billing_bot: confirm tax and revenue impact.
billing_bot: LEDGER CHECK: Reallocation is between AR accounts; net company revenue unchanged if we move billed platform from partner AR to customer AR. Tax code: TAXABLE_PLATFORM; taxing jurisdiction same for both accounts; we must reissue invoices with corrected tax lines and post adjustment to tax ledger. Recommend credit memo to partner and corrected invoice to customer; tax adj will be made by tax ops.
vp_finance: Approve partner credit $38,400 and corrected customer invoice $50,400. Capture approval note: "VP Finance 1965432100 approved reallocation of platform fee due to RULE-PARTNER-SPLIT bug; partner credit $38,400; corrected invoice for customer $50,400 NET-30. Require partner acknowledgement for credit or refund."
rachel_finance: Approved. Creating CM-2024-410P (partner credit) and INV-2024-410C (customer corrected invoice). Notifying both parties with explanation and OPS-1522 remediation summary.
omar_am: Partner replied: "We accept the credit applied to our account and request net refund of $12,000 for timing difference." I'll route to payments if they request payout.
rachel_finance: Marking thread closed pending OPS-1522 merge and partner settlement. Will follow up when payments processed.
